data_description.select_source: Action to run when a source is selected. Receives variable `source`.
data_description.turn_off: Action to run when the player is turned off.
data_description.turn_on: Action to run when the player is turned on (e.g. power on an AV receiver or run a script).
data_description.volume_down: Action to run when volume down is pressed.
data_description.volume_mute: Action to run when muting or unmuting. Receives variable `media_player_volume_muted` (boolean).
data_description.volume_up: Action to run when volume up is pressed (e.g. route to a dedicated amplifier).

commands.description: Map each media command to an action on a specific device. Leave empty to delegate the command to the active child player.
commands.title: Command routing

data_description.children: Media player entities whose state and playback commands this player will aggregate.

user.description: Combine one or more media players into a single media player entity.
user.title: Universal media player

reload.description: Reloads universal media players from the YAML-configuration.
reload.name: [%key:common::action::reload%]
